objects.description: [Qilin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1242) can make Registry modifications to share networked drives between elevated and non-elevated processes and to increase the number of outstanding network requests per client.(Citation: Halcyon Qilin.B OCT 2024)(Citation: Picus Qilin MAR 2025) [Qilin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1242) can also modify `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel\Desktop\Wallpaper` to enable posting of ransom messages.(Citation: Cisco Talos Qilin Ransomware OCT 2025)
